transitions.name: status-bar
transitions.motion: Zero-second requests use immediate window policy; other changes use the system bar fade. Screen-off and resume restore a hidden bar immediately.
transitions.verification: StatusBarFaderTest and StatusBarLifecycleScreensTest; system compositor and unlock must be checked on a device

transitions.name: settings-navigation
transitions.motion: Material AppMotion offset and effects; full container Start forward, End on pop
transitions.verification: MenuMotionScreensTest intermediate measured positions; AppScreensTest actual destinations

transitions.name: button-search-field
transitions.motion: One Material slide/fade from above for the top field and below for the bottom field; bottom placement follows IME insets
transitions.verification: MenuMotionScreensTest intermediate positions; UserFlowScreensTest real search entry

transitions.name: widget-and-app-menus
transitions.motion: Stock expressive DropdownMenuPopup and grouped shapes
transitions.verification: MenuMotionScreensTest rendered widget menu; no device frame-time claim

transitions.name: notification-sheet
transitions.motion: Stock ModalBottomSheet shared with calendar/weather; explicit close hides before removing owner
transitions.verification: NotificationScreensTest light/dark/large text; WeatherScreensTest shared viewport; UserFlowScreensTest actual sheet entry
